method: Scheduled Pillar Two 30-day news refresh (2 Nov 2026 HKT): WebSearch plus fetching primary official pages for OECD, HK IRD, SG IRAS/MOF/SSO, and JP NTA. Items added only when date and content were confirmed against a fetched source.

coverage.OECD: Checked 2 Nov 2026: OECD GIR XML Schema October 2026 publication page and PDF fetched — confirmed revised schema v2.0 reflecting Side-by-Side Package; v1.0 applies until 15 Jun 2028 and v2.0 from 25 Jun 2028. Release day taken as 20 Oct 2026 (KPMG TaxNewsFlash same day; PDF CreationDate 16 Oct). Added oecd-2026-10-20-gir-xml-schema-v2. Romania STTR deposit (2 Oct) already catalogued. Inclusive Framework plenary opening remarks (28 Oct) and G20 SG Tax Report (Oct) are high-level implementation status only — no new model-rules parameters to catalogue. No further post-16 Oct Pillar Two model-rules releases found.
coverage.HK: Checked 2 Nov 2026: IRD What's New fetched — 26 Oct 2026 entry announces Pillar Two Portal top-up tax return filing and electronic assessments for Part 4AA entities (FY beginning on/after 1 Jan 2025). IRD GMT/HKMTT page (bus_beps.htm) fetched — launch banner and updated Tax compliance / Pillar Two Portal sections confirm BIR82 e-filing and e-assessments; statutory 15/18-month deadlines unchanged. Added hk-2026-10-26-pillar-two-portal-return-filing. bus_p2.htm returns 404 (content lives on bus_beps.htm). No other new Pillar Two law/guidance in the window.
coverage.SG: Checked 2 Nov 2026: IRAS GloBE/DTT page fetched (Last updated 13 Oct 2026) with published QTI list for the Substance-based Tax Incentive Safe Harbour under DTT; QTI PDF fetched. Added sg-2026-10-13-iras-qti-list-sbti (in-window, not previously catalogued). MOF second-reading speech and Bill No. 22/2026 remain the latest enactment trail; SSO still hosts the Bill (no Acts-Supp / presidential assent page for Finance (Income Taxes) Act 2026 found on search). No new post-16 Oct official SG Pillar Two enactment or IRAS GloBE release beyond the QTI list catch-up.
coverage.JP: Checked 2 Nov 2026: NTA 新着情報 fetched — 21 Oct 2026 listing for 日本との間におけるGIRの自動的情報交換の実施対象国・地域. Partner-list PDF and GIR EOI hub page fetched; list as at 1 Oct 2026 with 25 partners (Slovakia outbound-only) and first exchange deadline 31 Mar 2027 confirmed. Added jp-2026-10-21-gir-exchange-partners. 趣旨説明 for 7 Aug circular (9 Oct) already catalogued. No further JP Pillar Two administrative guidance or GIR schema updates in the post-16 Oct window.
